Managed ASTC decoder copied from Switch_Toolbox/Switch_Toolbox_Library/FileFormats/ASTC:
ASTCDecoder.cs, ASTCPixel.cs, BitArrayStream.cs, IntegerEncoded.cs.
Source: https://github.com/KillzXGaming/Switch-Toolbox
The source retains its Ryujinx namespace and FasTC implementation reference.
The Toolbox repository's GPL-3.0 LICENSE is included alongside these files.

TOTK.frag is adapted from Toolbox/Shader/Bfres/BFRES_Totk.frag.
TexToGo layout and material bindings are ported from TXTG.cs and BFRES_Render.cs.
No Windows Forms, GDI, native texture decoder, or game resources are bundled.
